name: Hivemind: Monster Profits
source:
Congratulations! You're employed. 

You work middle management at Hivemind Monster Profits, an entrepreneurship consulting agency that gives business advice to the monster people of MNYC (Monster New York City).

Unfortunately, Hivemind's been down on their luck. Your busy bee girl CEO, Bianca, decides to sign a merger with a bear company in the same industry... And all sorts of antics ensue.

[From [url=https://alekirser.itch.io/hivemind-monster-profits]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！你被录用了。

你在“蜂巢思维：魔物创富”（Hivemind Monster Profits）担任中层管理人员——这是一家创业咨询机构，专门为魔物纽约市（MNYC）的魔物市民们提供商业建议。

不巧的是，“蜂巢思维”近来流年不利。你那忙得团团转的蜜蜂娘首席执行官比安卡，决定与同行业的另一家熊族企业签署合并协议……一连串鸡飞狗跳的闹剧也就此轮番上演。

[摘自[url=https://alekirser.itch.io/hivemind-monster-profits]itch.io[/url]]
